title: NASA-UAP-D032, STS-80 Unidentified Object Image 3, 1996
doc_notes: This document is a descriptive record of a UAP image captured by NASA astronauts during the STS-80 mission in 1996.

incidents.summary: Astronauts aboard Space Shuttle Columbia captured an image of an unidentified object in low-Earth orbit during the STS-80 mission.
behavior: continued along a trajectory passing between Columbia and the Earth
incidents.quote: A small, white, triangular or conical object is visible in the center of the sky.
